entries.title: Spinning Protoplanetary Disk with Colliding Dust Rings
entries.description: A bright central protostar with a wide, thin, semi-transparent disk of colored dust particles that orbit, collide, stick into clumps, and leave faint trails as growing planetesimals labeled with their mass.

entries.title: Runaway Growth of Planetesimals in a Dust Cloud
